fuel_consumption.source_quote: Based on projected 2007 fuel usage, such an increase would result in an increase to aircraft fuel expense of approximately $531 million in 2007, inclusive of the impact of effective fuel hedge instruments outstanding at December 31, 2006

instrument_type_details.notes: AMR uses jet fuel, heating oil, and crude oil hedging contracts (option and collar contracts), maturities up to 24 months. Net gains in fuel expense 2006: ~$97M; 2005: ~$64M; 2004: ~$99M. Additional $102M loss in Miscellaneous-net in 2006 for hedges that lost hedge accounting status. All derivatives settling after Dec 31, 2006 re-designated as hedges Oct 26, 2006.

warnings: Fuel consumption in gallons not explicitly stated; only dollar-based sensitivity disclosures provided.
